c2-act-0033: Paul and his party sail to Perga, and John departs from them and returns to Jerusalem. Let's read Acts 13:16.
c2-act-0034: Saul, who is also called Paul, looks intently at Elymas the sorcerer. Let's look at Acts 14:1 and 13:9 together.
c3-gal-0010: Paul travels to Jerusalem to see Peter and stays with him fifteen days. Let's read Galatians 2:2 and 1:18.
c3-rom-0021: Paul thanks God that word of the Romans' belief has spread through all the world. Let's read Romans 1:14 and 1:8.
c3-1co-0010: Word reaches Paul from Chloe's people that there are contentions among the Corinthians. Let's open First Corinthians 1:16 and 1:11.
c3-act-0035: From Miletus, Paul sends to Ephesus for the elders of the church. Let's read Acts 17:11 and 20:17.
c3-act-0036: Paul's companions arrive in Caesarea and stay with Philip the evangelist, one of the seven. Let's read Acts 19:12 and 21:8.
c3-act-0037: Claudius Lysias sends greetings to the most excellent governor Felix. Let's turn to Acts 22:3 and 23:26.
c3-act-0038: Agrippa tells Festus that Paul might have been set free if he had not appealed to Caesar. Let's read Acts 25:10 and 26:32.
c3-act-0039: Paul leaves Athens and heads to Corinth. Let's read Acts 27:5 and 18:1.
c2-eph-0008: Paul celebrates the mystery of God's will, revealed to us by His good pleasure. Let's check Ephesians 1:8.
c2-eph-0009: God is rich in mercy, because of His great love for us. Let's read Ephesians 1:7 and 2:4.
c3-eph-0010: Paul calls himself the prisoner of Christ Jesus for the Gentiles. Let's read Ephesians 1:12 and 3:1.
c3-eph-0011: God gave life to those who were dead in trespasses. Let's dig into Ephesians 3:6 and 2:1.
c3-eph-0012: Paul urges the church to work hard at keeping its unity. Let's read Ephesians 3:14 and 4:3.
c3-eph-0013: Ephesians speaks of a guarantee given for the purchased possession, to the praise of His glory. Let's read Ephesians 2:14 and 1:14.
c3-eph-0014: God can do exceedingly abundantly above all that we ask or think. Read Ephesians 1:5 and 3:20 with me.
c3-eph-0015: Believers are being built together into a home where God dwells. Let's read Ephesians 4:11 and 2:22.
c3-eph-0016: Paul calls for lowliness, gentleness, and longsuffering, bearing with one another in love. Let's read Ephesians 1:3 and 4:2.
c3-eph-0017: We were called in one hope of our calling, Paul says. Let's go to Ephesians 3:18 and 4:4.
c2-php-0016: Paul is sure that He who began a good work in the Philippians will complete it. Let's read Philippians 1:7.
c2-col-0005: Paul urges the Colossians to continue earnestly in prayer with thanksgiving. Let's read Colossians 1:2 and 4:2.
c3-php-0003: Paul has a prayer for the Philippians, and every word of it is worth hearing. Let's read Philippians 1:10 and 1:9.
c3-phm-0006: Epaphras, imprisoned with Paul in Christ Jesus, sends greetings. Let's read Philemon 1:25 and 1:23.
c3-act-0040: In Rome, Paul is permitted to dwell by himself, with one soldier keeping watch. Let's read Acts 28:20 and 28:16.
c3-eph-0019: Paul writes to the believers in Ephesus by the will of God. Let's look at Ephesians 6:23 and 1:1 together.
c3-col-0006: We give thanks to the Father, who has qualified us to share in the light. Let's read Colossians 4:5 and 1:12.
c3-php-0004: Paul thanks the Philippians for their fellowship in the gospel from the very start until now. Let's read Philippians 1:1 and 1:5.
c3-act-0041: Paul tells how the Romans examined him and wished to release him. Let's open Acts 28:31 and 28:18.
c3-php-0005: Paul opens his letter by wishing the Philippians grace from God our Father. Let's read Philippians 1:8 and 1:2.
c2-1ti-0005: Paul recalls that he was once a persecutor, yet he obtained mercy. Let's read First Timothy 1:12.
c2-1ti-0006: Paul warns against fables and endless genealogies that cause disputes. Let's turn to First Timothy 3:6 and 1:4.
c3-1ti-0007: The law is good if one uses it lawfully, Paul says. Let's read First Timothy 3:2 and 1:8.
c3-2ti-0006: Timothy is called to be a good soldier of Jesus Christ, ready for hardship. Let's read Second Timothy 2:5 and 2:3.
c3-2ti-0007: Paul asks Timothy for the cloak he left at Troas, and the books, especially the parchments. Let's check Second Timothy 4:11 and 4:13.
c3-1ti-0008: Paul calls the mystery of godliness great, without controversy. Let's read First Timothy 1:7 and 3:16.
c3-1ti-0009: God alone has immortality, dwelling in unapproachable light. Let's read First Timothy 1:3 and 6:16.
c3-1ti-0010: Paul urges Timothy to avoid profane and idle babblings. Let's dig into First Timothy 3:4 and 6:20.
c3-2ti-0008: Paul tells Timothy to stir up the gift of God that is in him. Let's read Second Timothy 1:12 and 2:11.
c3-2ti-0009: Paul urges Timothy to do his utmost to come before winter. Let's read Second Timothy 2:12 and 4:21.
c2-php-0006: Whatever the motive, Paul rejoices that Christ is preached. Read Philippians 1:13 with me.
c2-php-0007: Paul is set for the defense of the gospel, Philippians says. Let's read Philippians 1:12 and 1:17.
c3-php-0008: Being in the form of God, Christ Jesus did not consider equality with God robbery. Let's read Philippians 2:8 and 2:6.
c3-php-0009: Paul admits that if anyone could boast in outward things, he could, and more so. Let's go to Philippians 1:15 and 3:4.
c3-php-0010: Paul hopes the Philippians' rejoicing will abound when he comes to them again. Let's read Philippians 3:12 and 1:26.
c3-php-0011: Paul warns the Philippians: beware of dogs, beware of evil workers. Let's read Philippians 1:14 and 3:2.
c3-php-0012: God has highly exalted Jesus and given Him the name above every name. Let's look closely at Philippians 1:23 and 2:9.
c3-php-0013: Paul presses toward the goal for the prize of the upward call of God. Let's read Philippians 1:16 and 3:14.
c3-php-0014: Paul expects that their prayers will turn out for his deliverance. Let's read Philippians 3:7 and 1:19.
c3-php-0015: Paul expects to remain with the Philippians for their progress and joy. Let's look at Philippians 3:13 and 1:25 together.
c2-heb-0013: Hebrews shows that all the angels of God worship the Son. Let's read Hebrews 1:9.
c2-heb-0014: God did not subject the world to come to angels. Let's read Hebrews 1:12 and 2:5.
c3-heb-0015: Hebrews calls us to consider Christ Jesus, the High Priest of our confession. Let's open Hebrews 2:11 and 3:1.
c3-heb-0016: Though He was a Son, Jesus learned obedience by the things He suffered. Let's read Hebrews 3:2 and 5:8.
c3-heb-0017: Having been perfected, Jesus became the author of eternal deliverance for all who obey Him. Let's read Hebrews 7:4 and 5:9.
c3-heb-0018: Jesus promises to sing praise to the Father in the midst of the assembly. Let's turn to Hebrews 1:14 and 2:12.
c3-heb-0019: To the Son, God says His throne is forever and ever. Let's read Hebrews 3:6 and 1:8.
c3-heb-0020: Jesus is worthy of more glory than Moses, as a builder has more honor than what he builds. Let's read Hebrews 7:13 and 3:3.
c3-heb-0021: Our Lord arose from Judah, my own tribe, which Moses never spoke of for priesthood. Let's check Hebrews 10:11 and 7:14.
c3-heb-0022: Jesus has become the surety of a better covenant. Let's read Hebrews 2:13 and 7:22.
c2-rom-0022: Paul reminds us that all have sinned and fall short of the glory of God. Let's read Romans 3:25.
c2-2co-0009: The love of Christ compels us, Paul says. Let's dig into Second Corinthians 5:16 and 5:14.
c3-gal-0011: Paul quotes the law: the man who does them shall live by them. Let's read Galatians 3:11 and 3:12.
c3-heb-0023: Even the first covenant was not dedicated without blood. Let's read Hebrews 9:16 and 9:18.
c3-1pe-0009: Christ suffered for us, leaving us an example to follow in His steps. Read First Peter 2:22 and 2:21 with me.
c3-rom-0023: The righteousness of God apart from the law is revealed, witnessed by the Law and the Prophets. Let's read Romans 3:26 and 3:21.
c3-2co-0010: Christ died for all, so that those who live would live for Him who rose again. Let's read Second Corinthians 5:21 and 5:15.
c3-1pe-0010: When He was reviled, Jesus did not revile in return, but committed Himself to God. Let's go to First Peter 2:24 and 2:23.
c3-heb-0024: Christ will appear again to those who eagerly wait for Him. Let's read Hebrews 9:15 and 9:28.
c3-heb-0025: Hebrews says the copies were cleansed one way, but the true things need something better. Let's read Hebrews 9:27 and 9:23.
